race.comment: SWIFT LEGEND (4) improving gelding expected to go on with it this prep. Produced slick closing splits first-up with a narrow fifth over 1300m at Warwick Farm with the 59.5kg. Comes to hand quickly and will keep improving as he gets out in trip. Strong winning chance. THE MONA LISA (1) deep into the campaign and the visors come off from a low gate. Never on the track when she loomed strongly for a game second over 1600m here in Midway class. Stalks the speed and can go one better if she hasn't trained off. ALL STAR (11) racing in career-best form this prep with the two wins from his last three runs. Has a sticky gate again and backs up quickly. LET'S FLY (5) scored a long overdue win from the rails draw last start, awkward map today and place best.
